def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} → {β : Sort u_4} → (p : α → Prop) → [DecidablePred p] → (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  intro α β p x₀
  have h₁ : ∀ (a : α), Decidable (p a) := by
    intro a
    exact inferInstance
  -- Define the forward direction of the equivalence
  let f : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ =>
    fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a
  -- Define the inverse direction of the equivalence
  let g : ({ a // ¬p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } := fun y =>
    ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩, by
      intro ⟨a, ha⟩
      simp [ha]
      <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;>
      aesop⟩
  -- Prove that f and g are inverses of each other
  have h₂ : Function.Bijective f := by
    have h₃ : Function.Injective f := by
      intro ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ h
      have h₄ : x₁ = x₂ := by
        funext a
        by_cases h₅ : p a
        · -- Case: p a is true
          have h₆ : (⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a = x₁ a := rfl
          have h₇ : (⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a = x₂ a := rfl
          have h₈ : (⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a = (⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a := by
            have h₉ := congr_fun h ⟨a, h₅⟩
            simp_all [f]
          simp_all
        · -- Case: p a is false
          have h₆ : (⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a = x₁ a := rfl
          have h₇ : (⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }).1 a = x₂ a := rfl
          have h₈ : x₁ a = x₂ a := by
            have h₉ : (f ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩) ⟨a, h₅⟩ = (f ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩) ⟨a, h₅⟩ := by rw [h]
            simp [f] at h₉
            <;> simp_all
          simp_all
      exact Subtype.ext h₄
    have h₄ : Function.Surjective f := by
      intro y
      use g y
      ext ⟨a, ha⟩
      simp [f, g]
      <;>
      simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;>
      aesop
    exact ⟨h₃, h₄⟩
  -- Construct the equivalence
  exact
    {
      toFun := f
      invFun := g
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        have h₅ := h₂.1
        have h₆ := h₂.2
        have h₇ : f (g y) = y := by
          have h₈ : Function.Surjective f := h₂.2
          have h₉ : Function.Injective f := h₂.1
          have h₁₀ : f (g y) = y := by
            have h₁₁ : f (g y) = y := by
              ext ⟨a, ha⟩
              simp [f, g]
              <;>
              simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
              <;>
              aesop
            exact h₁₁
          exact h₁₀
        simp_all [Function.leftInverse_invFun]
        <;>
        aesop
      right_inv := by
        intro x
        have h₅ := h₂.1
        have h₆ := h₂.2
        have h₇ : g (f x) = x := by
          have h₈ : Function.Surjective f := h₂.2
          have h₉ : Function.Injective f := h₂.1
          have h₁₀ : g (f x) = x := by
            have h₁₁ : g (f x) = x := by
              cases x with
              | mk x hx =>
                ext a
                simp [f, g] at *
                <;>
                by_cases h : p a <;>
                simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff] <;>
                aesop
            exact h₁₁
          exact h₁₀
        simp_all [Function.rightInverse_invFun]
        <;>
        aesop
    }
